name: systemd

commands.command:
mkdir -p build
cd       build

meson setup ..                \
      --prefix=/usr           \
      --buildtype=release     \
      -D default-dnssec=no    \
      -D firstboot=false      \
      -D install-tests=false  \
      -D ldconfig=false       \
      -D sysusers=false       \
      -D rpmmacrosdir=no      \
      -D homed=disabled       \
      -D man=disabled         \
      -D mode=release         \
      -D pamconfdir=no        \
      -D dev-kvm-mode=0660    \
      -D nobody-group=nogroup \
      -D sysupdate=disabled   \
      -D ukify=disabled       \
      -D docdir=/usr/share/doc/systemd-{version}

echo 'NAME="Linux From Scratch"' > /etc/os-release
unshare -m ninja test

description: The systemd package contains programs for controlling the startup, running, and shutdown of the system.

installed_descriptions.name: bootctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to control EFI firmware boot settings on a system

installed_descriptions.name: busctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to introspect and monitor the D-Bus bus

installed_descriptions.name: coredumpctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to retrieve coredumps from the systemd journal

installed_descriptions.name: halt
installed_descriptions.description: Normally invokes shutdown with the -h option, except when already in run-level 0, when it tells the kernel to halt the system; it notes in the file /var/log/wtmp that the system is being brought down

installed_descriptions.name: hostnamectl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to query and change the system hostname and related settings

installed_descriptions.name: init
installed_descriptions.description: Is the first process to be started after the kernel has initialized the hardware; init takes over the boot process and starts the processes specified by its configuration files; in this case, it starts systemd

installed_descriptions.name: journalctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to query the contents of the systemd journal

installed_descriptions.name: kernel-install
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to add and remove kernel and initramfs images to and from /boot; in LFS, this is done manually

installed_descriptions.name: localectl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to query and change the system locale and keyboard layout settings

installed_descriptions.name: loginctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to introspect and control the state of the systemd Login Manager

installed_descriptions.name: machinectl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to introspect and control the state of the systemd Virtual Machine and Container Registration Manager

installed_descriptions.name: networkctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to introspect and configure the state of the network links configured by systemd-networkd

installed_descriptions.name: oomctl
installed_descriptions.description: Controls the systemd Out Of Memory daemon

installed_descriptions.name: portablectl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to attach or detach portable services from the local system

installed_descriptions.name: poweroff
installed_descriptions.description: Instructs the kernel to halt the system and switch off the computer (see halt)

installed_descriptions.name: reboot
installed_descriptions.description: Instructs the kernel to reboot the system (see halt)

installed_descriptions.name: resolvconf
installed_descriptions.description: Registers DNS server and domain configuration with systemd-resolved

installed_descriptions.name: resolvectl
installed_descriptions.description: Sends control commands to the network name resolution manager, or resolves domain names, IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, DNS records, and services

installed_descriptions.name: run0
installed_descriptions.description: Temporarily elevates or acquires different privileges, similar to sudo

installed_descriptions.name: runlevel
installed_descriptions.description: Outputs the previous and the current run-level, as noted in the last run-level record in /run/utmp

installed_descriptions.name: shutdown
installed_descriptions.description: Brings the system down in a safe and secure manner, signaling all processes and notifying all logged-in users

installed_descriptions.name: systemctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to introspect and control the state of the systemd system and service manager

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-ac-power
installed_descriptions.description: Reports whether the system is connected to an external power source.

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-analyze
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to analyze system startup performance, as well as identify troublesome systemd units

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-ask-password
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to query a system password or passphrase from the user, using a message specified on the Linux command line

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-cat
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to connect the STDOUT and STDERR outputs of a process with the systemd journal

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-cgls
installed_descriptions.description: Recursively shows the contents of the selected Linux control group hierarchy in a tree

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-cgtop
installed_descriptions.description: Shows the top control groups of the local Linux control group hierarchy, ordered by their CPU, memory and disk I/O loads

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-creds
installed_descriptions.description: Displays and processes credentials

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-delta
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to identify and compare configuration files in /etc that override the defaults in /usr

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-detect-virt
installed_descriptions.description: Detects whether the system is being run in a virtual environment, and adjusts udev accordingly

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-dissect
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to inspect OS disk images

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-escape
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to escape strings for inclusion in systemd unit names

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-hwdb
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to manage the hardware database (hwdb)

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-id128
installed_descriptions.description: Generates and prints id128 (UUID) strings

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-inhibit
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to execute a program with a shutdown, sleep or idle inhibitor lock taken, preventing an action such as a system shutdown until the process is completed

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-machine-id-setup
installed_descriptions.description: Is used by system installer tools to initialize the machine ID stored in /etc/machine-id at install time with a randomly generated ID

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-mount
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to temporarily mount or automount disks

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-notify
installed_descriptions.description: Is used by daemon scripts to notify the init system of status changes

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-nspawn
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to run a command, or an entire OS, in a light-weight namespace container

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-path
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to query system and user paths

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-pty-forward
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to run a command with a custom terminal background color or title

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-repart
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to grow and add partitions to a partition table when systemd is used with an OS image (e.g. a container)

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-resolve
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to resolve domain names, IPV4 and IPv6 addresses, DNS resource records, and services

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-run
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to create and start a transient .service or a .scope unit and run the specified command in it; this is useful for validating systemd units

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-socket-activate
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to listen on socket devices and launch a process upon a successful connection to the socket

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-sysext
installed_descriptions.description: Activates system extension images

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-tmpfiles
installed_descriptions.description: Creates, deletes, and cleans up volatile and temporary files and directories, based on the configuration file format and location specified in tmpfiles.d directories

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-umount
installed_descriptions.description: Unmounts mount points

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-tty-ask-password-agent
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to list and/or process pending systemd password requests

installed_descriptions.name: systemd-vpick
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to resolve paths to a ".v/" versioned directory

installed_descriptions.name: timedatectl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to query and change the system clock and its settings

installed_descriptions.name: udevadm
installed_descriptions.description: Is a generic udev administration tool which controls the udevd daemon, provides info from the udev hardware database, monitors uevents, waits for uevents to finish, tests udev configuration, and triggers uevents for a given device

installed_descriptions.name: userdbctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to inspect users, groups, and group memberships

installed_descriptions.name: varlinkctl
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to interact with and invoke Varlink services

installed_descriptions.name: libsystemd
installed_descriptions.description: Is the main systemd utility library

installed_descriptions.name: libudev
installed_descriptions.description: Is a library to access Udev device information
